name: Gortex
description: Your AI's live map of your codebase — every call, dependency, and contract indexed across your repos, shared across every running agent via a local daemon. Gives Claude Code 52 graph-aware tools so they answer "what calls this?", "what breaks if I rename UserStore?", or "which services consume this endpoint?" in one call instead of grepping for minutes. Real AST parsing across 92 languages — deterministic, zero LLM calls during indexing. Useful before refactoring, when tracing bugs across services, exploring unfamiliar code, or any time your agent reaches for Grep or Read. Returns precise answers tagged with confidence tiers (compiler-grade vs heuristic). Local-first, source-available, free under defined thresholds.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **5 commands**, **4 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (5): `gortex-debug` (Use when the user is debugging a bug, tracing an error, or asking why something fails), `gortex-explore` (Use when the user asks how code works, wants to understand architecture, trace execution flows, or explore unfamiliar…), `gortex-guide` (Use when the user asks about Gortex — available tools, graph schema, or workflow reference), `gortex-impact` (Use when the user wants to know what will break if they change something, or needs safety analysis…), `gortex-refactor` (Use when the user wants to rename, extract, split, move, or restructure code safely)
- **Commands** (5): `gortex-debug`, `gortex-explore`, `gortex-guide`, `gortex-impact`, `gortex-refactor`
- **Hooks** (4): `PreToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `Stop`, `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (1): `gortex`

Installs with `claude plugin install gortex@claude-community` from `gortexhq/claude-plugin`.
